# Airport Reference Data

Place a versioned real airport reference at `data/external/airports.csv` before a
real BTS run. It must contain at least `iata_code` and IANA `timezone` columns;
include source and license metadata in the file or accompanying documentation.

The committed three-airport mapping lives under `data/samples/` and is synthetic
smoke-test support only. It is not a complete or authoritative airport dataset.
